description: This file contains extension methods for configuring and customizing the Orleans IClientBuilder, including connection retry policies, clustering options, and event handlers.

classes.name: ClientBuilderExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for configuring Orleans IClientBuilder instances.

classes.name: DelegateConnectionRetryFilter
classes.description: Private sealed class implementing IClientConnectionRetryFilter, wrapping a delegate for retry logic.

methods.name: UseConnectionRetryFilter
methods.description: Configures a connection retry filter using a delegate.

methods.name: UseConnectionRetryFilter
methods.description: Configures a connection retry filter using an IClientConnectionRetryFilter instance.

methods.name: UseConnectionRetryFilter
methods.description: Configures a connection retry filter using a specified TConnectionRetryFilter type.

methods.name: ConfigureServices
methods.description: Adds services to the IClientBuilder's service collection.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Registers a configuration action for a specific options type.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Binds a configuration instance to a specific options type.

methods.name: AddGatewayCountChangedHandler
methods.description: Registers a GatewayCountChangedHandler via a factory.

methods.name: AddClusterConnectionStatusObserver
methods.description: Registers a cluster connection status observer.

methods.name: AddClusterConnectionStatusObserver
methods.description: Registers a cluster connection status observer via type.

methods.name: AddClusterConnectionLostHandler
methods.description: Registers a ConnectionToClusterLostHandler via a factory.

methods.name: AddActivityPropagation
methods.description: Enables propagation of Activity.Current through grain calls.

methods.name: UseLocalhostClustering
methods.description: Configures the client to connect to a local silo on localhost with default or specified ports, service id, and cluster id.

methods.name: UseStaticClustering
methods.description: Configures the client to use static clustering with specified endpoints or options.
